# Test fixtures

Generated by `python3 tests/fixtures/generate.py` using the canonical serializer, so valid fixtures satisfy `serialize(parse(text)) == text`. `canonical-hashes.json` holds their SHA-256 sums; the Python and JavaScript tests both check them, which proves the two serializers are byte-identical.

| File | Content | Used by |
|------|---------|---------|
| `simple.json` | Root + wave/math/null CHOPs, an expression parameter, 2 connections | schema, serialization, exporter, importer, round-trip, diff |
| `nested.json` | Nested COMP, multi-index connections (`fromIndex`/`toIndex` 1) | exporter, importer, round-trip, layout |
| `dat.json` | Text DAT and table DAT with content | exporter, importer, merge (table cells) |
| `empty.json` | Root COMP only | edge cases, repo history helper |
| `before.json`, `after.json` | One added node, one removed node, one changed parameter, one changed DAT line, rewired connections | diff tests, reload tests, viewer demo, quickstart steps 4–6 |
| `malformed.json` | Broken JSON | error handling (US3) |
| `invalid-schema.json` | Node without `type` | validation |
| `dangling-connection.json` | Connection to a missing node | validation |
| `future-version.json` | `format_version: 99` | unsupported-version error |
| `merge/<scenario>/{base,ours,theirs}.json` | Three-way inputs; `expected.json` for clean merges, `conflicts.json` listing the expected conflicts | merge tests, merge-flow test, fixture repos |

Merge scenarios: `disjoint`, `identical`, `dat-merge` (clean); `param-conflict`, `edit-vs-delete`, `add-add`, `connection-vs-delete`, `dat-conflict` (conflicts); `quickstart` (quickstart step 7: one conflict plus two non-clashing edits to the same node).

`tests/js/fixture-repo.js` builds throwaway Git repositories from these fixtures (`history`, `merge <scenario>`).
